title: The port history carried by the district's streets
dek: A source layer for routes, capsules and local programming that connects rue de la Commune and the civic core to the working waterfront beside them.

chapters.title: Begin on rue de la Commune
chapters.intro: The strongest district entry is not a generic Old Montréal image. It is a documented working street with warehouses, rail and the port immediately beside it.

chapters.title: Show the district inside the port system
chapters.intro: The early aerials connect Place d'Armes, the urban grid and the shoreline. They give street stories a geographic structure rather than a decorative backdrop.

chapters.title: Follow the working shoreline
chapters.intro: Dated port reports let a guide or editor move between images as a sequence while keeping report-level claims separate from what any one frame proves.

chapters.title: Ask how the visitor district emerged
chapters.intro: The 1980 hangar report gives a source-linked starting point for a later transformation story. Additional evidence is still needed before that story becomes a public claim.

activations.title: Rue de la Commune source walk
activations.audience: Local guides, visitors and member businesses along the route
activations.use: A concise walking sequence that links the working street, Bonsecours and the port edge through exact archive records.
activations.dependency: Local guide review, viewpoint checks and a clear member participation model.

activations.title: Chronicle-ready source packet
activations.use: A prepared set of images, archive wording, source links and open questions for one tightly scoped historical capsule.
activations.dependency: Episode research, voice selection, bilingual writing and final rights clearance.

activations.title: Member window trail
activations.audience: Businesses connecting the district to a seasonal cultural route
activations.use: A small distributed display where each location carries one source-linked record and points to the complete evidence sequence.
activations.dependency: Business recruitment, print production, accessibility review and route operations.

nextStep: Choose one rue de la Commune capsule, review it with a local guide and two member businesses, then measure whether the source layer improves the public story.
